Name: Set windowed resolution
Description: Queue a normal window with whole-pixel dimensions. The native setter fits the rectangle to 16:9; desktop and renderer heap limits can reduce the actual size. Wait for an existing resize before issuing another request.
RestoreBehavior: Completed requests remain applied after disconnect. Later game settings or window changes can replace them.

Evidence.Finding: Mode 0 copies two float32 dimensions under GX+31432 with native float32 fit and integer truncation. The normal render frame later performs fence/rebuild/window work.
Evidence.Level: Full native ASM, exact original PE bytes and isolated original-body/lifecycle tests. Live graphics validation is pending.

Name: Maximize game window
Description: Queue native maximized window mode. This exits exclusive fullscreen through the normal game resize path; it does not select or enumerate a new fullscreen mode.
RestoreBehavior: Completed requests remain applied after disconnect. Later game settings or window changes can replace them.

Evidence.Finding: Mode 2 of 124FE0 leaves the request dimensions unchanged, sets native mode 2/fullscreen false, and marks a change by comparison.123020 later uses ShowWindow(3).
Evidence.Level: Full native ASM, exact original PE bytes and isolated original-body/lifecycle tests. Live graphics validation is pending.

Name: Actual render width
Description: Current native render width after any completed resource resize; the command acknowledgement alone does not establish this result.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only snapshot. No effect is applied or restored. All six fields are omitted if the renderer/window lease, synchronization or native state is invalid.

Evidence.Finding: GX+8/+12 are copied under the presentation mutex. Bounds 1..16384 are an explicit diagnostic policy.
Evidence.Level: Full native ASM, exact original PE bytes and isolated original-body/lifecycle tests. Live graphics validation is pending.

Name: Native active window mode
Description: Mode 0 windowed, 1 exclusive fullscreen, 2 maximized. This is the consumed native mode field, not a separate OS-window or successful fullscreen-transition probe.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only snapshot. No effect is applied or restored. All six fields are omitted if the renderer/window lease, synchronization or native state is invalid.

Evidence.Finding: 119E90 copies request mode +1028 to active1048; later native window/resource work may still fail or be superseded. Only integer 0..2 is published.
Evidence.Level: Full native ASM, exact original PE bytes and isolated original-body/lifecycle tests. Live graphics validation is pending.

Name: Window change pending or blocked
Description: 1 means a pending/active dirty request, positive native retry, resource transition, or native size-handler suppression.0 means these fields are idle; it does not prove that a particular prior request completed successfully.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only snapshot. No effect is applied or restored. All six fields are omitted if the renderer/window lease, synchronization or native state is invalid.

Evidence.Finding: Under resize CS reads +1024,1044,1040,1072 and1064. Invalid flags/countdown/modes/dimensions suppress the full six-value snapshot. A busy CS is unavailable, not idle.
Evidence.Level: Full native ASM, exact original PE bytes and isolated original-body/lifecycle tests. Live graphics validation is pending.

Name: Stored request width
Description: Last stored native request width after 16:9 fitting. Maximization preserves this field, so it is not the maximized client width.
RestoreBehavior: Read-only snapshot. No effect is applied or restored. All six fields are omitted if the renderer/window lease, synchronization or native state is invalid.
